feedback: The candidate changes one variable from the best raced design, iteration 4 (kp 7.0, kd 0.5, 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.030 m, base_speed 1.4, ki 0.05, last_direction). kd goes from 0.5 to 0.6, and kp, geometry, base_speed, ki and line_loss stay the same. Iteration 4 scored 94.32 but ran off track on all 60 trials. Its oval steering_oscillation was 0.267, still above the 0.2 concern level, and rose from 0.250 at kd 0.4 when kd moved to 0.5. The s-bend (0.162) and slalom (0.119) oscillation were low. Oval max_error was 0.064, just over the 0.06 limit. Line losses were 1.6 on the oval, 1.35 on the s-bend and 1.0 on the slalom, and progress was 0.46, 0.15 and 0.09. Body width cannot relax the off-track limit, so control must fix it. Nothing here states how this candidate will perform. It is a sound, low-risk next step with 4 review runs left, so approve it to race and get per-track telemetry. After the race: if oval steering_oscillation is still above 0.2, reduce kp toward 6.5 rather than raising kd further, since kd 0.6 already costs response speed. If oscillation falls and max_error is still at or above 0.06, widen the array to x = ±0.040 m and test kp near 8. If line losses stay at the same bend entries, test line_loss search_left or search_right, favouring the side the failing bends turn towards.
requested_changes: After the race: if oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.2 at kd 0.6, reduce controller.kp toward 6.5, since iteration 4 showed oscillation rising with kd (0.250 at kd 0.4, 0.267 at kd 0.5) and further damping alone is not closing the gap.

After the race: if steering_oscillation is low but max_error stays at or above 0.06 (iteration 4 oval max_error was 0.064), widen geometry.sensor_positions to x = ±0.040 m and test controller.kp near 8.0, because iteration 3 to 4 showed the edge response is what holds max_error near 0.06.

After the race: if line_loss_events stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries (iteration 4: 1.6 oval, 1.35 s-bend, 1.0 slalom), change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_left or search_right, choosing the side the failing bends turn towards, and raise base_speed toward 1.6 only if progress is still below 1 with max_error under 0.06.
